newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up on short-position squaring.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up on short-position squaring.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on squaring of short positions on Monday's settlement day, and are likely to open mixed on Tuesday, dealers said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index ended 9.10 points, or 0.66 percent, up at 1,383.73 amid 154 advancing issues and 87 losing ones.
"The strength in most active stocks with squaring of short positions prompted the rise," dealer Ali Raza said.
There were some indications that investors were now shifting towards long positions, he said.
There was no direction in the market and prices are likely to open mixed on Tuesday's new account day, a dealer at Taurus Securities said
PTCL rose 0.40 to 32.25 rupees, Hub Power 0.50 to 31.40, Fauji Fertilizer 1.15 to 70.85 and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.50 to 24.65.
